requiredEdits.issue: The note states the frozen `verify:qc:coop-campaign-journey` chain 'fails deterministically (re-run once, same signature) on a blanket console-error assertion collecting four 403 responses' as a standing, current fact. PR #1720 (title 'fix(campaign): stop a co-op guest asking for the GM share grants it cannot list', merge commit f685a5391f6e69b73932cdef5323dd2d247e55a6) fixed exactly this defect and merged to origin/main at 2026-09-15T14:47:55Z -- 7 minutes BEFORE this batch's own commit was authored (2026-09-15T14:54:47Z / 08:54:47-06:00), and confirmed an ancestor of origin/main via `git merge-base --is-ancestor f685a5391 origin/main`. PR #1720's own body states its root-cause fix was verified by re-running the frozen journey once on a fresh E2E standalone build: 'exit 0, 9 jest suites / 138 tests, both Playwright specs green, zero 403s in the log.' The row's own cited receipt (camp01bc-receipt-run-main-20260915.json) independently traces the four 403s to `GET /api/campaigns/<id>/grants` failing the `not-campaign-gm` gate -- the exact defect #1720's diagnosis and fix target. The row is silent about #1720 entirely, so it now describes a fixed defect as an unqualified standing failure.
